events.title: Camera Zoom Change
events.summary: Based on some feedback, we are thinking of changing the camera zoom for the game. Currently you can see all of most rooms. Some rooms, such as the example below, are larger and the camera will follow you as you move. We received a comment that maybe we were showing too much. We went ahead and experimented with different zoom levels. We are liking 1.5x. What do you think? We'd love to hear feedback from players before we make a final decision. events.title: 0.10.1 - Polishing
events.summary: After releasing our last update we found some little things that were not quite right, so here we are with another update. The main change here is that the popup notifications have been updated to allow more variety between different types. The popups for Achievements are meant to be big and stand out. events.title: 0.10.0 - Balancing
events.summary: Another day, another update. In this update we have done balancing and reworked the dungeons a bit. Certain enemies, including bosses, have been updated. Some have been renamed. Some have had some art updated. Some have been made more challenging. Many anti-dash crystals have been removed and the puzzle or trap redesigned to not need them. Scoring has been updated to reduce the penalty for using continues.There are now many more Achievements, and types of Achievements. We also updated the order

events.title: 0.9.0 - Achievements Unlocked
events.summary: Achievements have been added to the game. This first batch focuses on defeating enemies and breakable objects. Additional achievements are planned covering other areas. As you complete them, a notification will show. You can see which you have completed from the main menu. Incomplete ones will be greyed out. events.title: 0.8.0 - UI/UX Feedback
events.summary: As Next Fest approaches we are working to get some final changes out. This update is largely based on recent feedback from ShiftyGameDev's Twitch stream of our game and trying to make things clearer to the player. We created our dragon characters a while ago and designed them to work with an asset pack we were using at the time. events.title: 0.7.0 - Intro Cutscene
events.summary: We have updated the game's intro sequence. There is now a short cutscene of Eldwyn speaking to a group of students, before they portal away to take their exam/quiz. This can be turned of from the main menu, allowing you to get right into the game on replays.The main menu has also been updated. This was originally created for a game jam, and the menu had largely stayed with the Spin to Win theme of the jam, while the rest of the game evolved away from it. The menu now better fits the game. events.title: 0.6.0 - Voice Acting & Steam Demo
events.summary: We've made a number of changes for this release. The highlight is the voice acting. All dialog is now fully voiced. There are currently 2 characters, each with their own voice and personality.This is also the first version being released as a demo on Steam.In the Dialog tab there is an option to disable dialog VO.
